newsitem.title: USA: D&N to take Q3 charge of $0.47/shr.
newsitem.headline: D&N to take Q3 charge of $0.47/shr.

text.p: D&N Financial Corp said Tuesday it expects to record a $5.6 million pretax charge that will reduce third quarter earnings by $0.47 a share.
The charge is part of a mandated contribution to replenish the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp's depleted Savings Association Insurance Fund, the company said
The mandate, which has been expected for more than one year, is part of a law that requires thrifts to pay a one-time assessment to restore the fund to its statutory reserve level.
The new law will reduce D&N's annual deposit insurance premiums from 26 basis points per $100 in deposits to about 6.5 basis points, effective January 1, 1997, equal to about $2 million a year.
The company said it expects to announce its quarterly earnings on October 16.
